lignes.pinyin: tā de mén suǒ huài le dǎ bù kāi
lignes.fr: Sa serrure est cassée, la porte ne s'ouvre plus.
lignes.en: His lock is broken and the door won't open.

lignes.pinyin: tā zhǐ hǎo qǐng rén bǎ mén qiào kāi
lignes.fr: Il doit faire forcer la porte.
lignes.en: He has to get someone to prise the door open.

lignes.zh: 小狗在门里翘着尾巴等他。
lignes.pinyin: xiǎo gǒu zài mén lǐ qiào zhe wěi ba děng tā
lignes.fr: Derrière la porte, le chiot l'attend, la queue dressée.
lignes.en: Behind the door, the puppy waits for him with its tail up.

glossaire.en: to have no choice but to
(marks the object of the verb); to hold
